findings.source_quote: “...Mothers who were applauded by society were suddenly bombarded with a new buzzword—fullfillment.”
findings.suggested_fix: “...Moeders wat deur die samelewing toegejuig is, is skielik met ’n nuwe modewoord bestook—vervulling.” (Preserve the source’s printed word as intended: “fulfillment” means ‘vervulling’, not an alternate concept.)
